name: luma-beauty-agent
description: Demo beauty store with 100-product RAG, Google ADK and Agent Runtime, React storefront, Firebase, Cloud Run and documented deployment costs.

paragraphs: Luma Beauty is an end-to-end AI commerce demo: a responsive storefront, an updatable 100-product skincare catalog, and a shopping agent that turns natural-language needs into recommendations backed by product evidence.

The project connects a React interface to a Python API and a Google ADK agent deployed on Google Agent Runtime using Google's agents-cli. It demonstrates how to build, deploy, and operate a small RAG application with authentication, persistent conversations, versioned data, and explicit usage controls.
Live demo · Architecture · Setup · Deployment · Costs
features: Marketplace navigation, search, category/budget filters, details and simulated cart.
Centered AI chat with an animated Blobatar, thinking states, launcher transitions,
keyboard focus handling, mobile layout and reduced-motion support.
RAG using Gemini embeddings, in-memory similarity, keywords and hard filters.
Grounded recommendation IDs; canonical product cards supplied by the API.

requirements.text: Billing alerts notify; application quotas provide chat usage control rather than a total cloud spending cap.
